original_ai_output.title_zh: 加纳全国民主大会党称任命Emelia Agbenyo为选举委员会副主席不存在利益冲突
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 加纳全国民主大会党（NDC）选举与信息技术全国副主任Rashid Tanko-Computer否认了有关前党发言人Emelia Agbenyo被任命为选举委员会（EC）副主席可能存在利益冲突的担忧。该表态由单一来源MyJoyOnline报道，尚未获得其他来源交叉验证。

key_facts.fact: NDC全国副主任Rashid Tanko-Computer否认任命Emelia Agbenyo为选举委员会副主席存在利益冲突
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Deputy National Director of Elections and IT of the National Democratic Congress (NDC), Rashid Tanko-Computer, has dismissed concerns about a potential conflict of interest in the appointment of former party spokesperson Emelia Agbenyo as a Deputy Chairperson of the Electoral Commission (EC).

key_facts.fact: Emelia Agbenyo为NDC前发言人，被任命为选举委员会副主席
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the appointment of former party spokesperson Emelia Agbenyo as a Deputy Chairperson of the Electoral Commission (EC)

key_facts.fact: 该报道目前为单一来源
